privacy: Sanitized numeric evidence only; no prompts, generated text, raw request IDs, absolute paths, credentials, or wall-clock timestamps.

source.state: Measurements include an experimental dirty worktree derived from base_commit; base_commit is not claimed as the tested candidate revision.

method.mechanical: 5 measured waves plus 1 excluded warmup; cold cache; fixed 512 output tokens; ignore EOS; actual concurrency required; zero errors and retractions.

metric_definitions.e2e_output_tps: Median of per-wave aggregate emitted output-token rates.
metric_definitions.prefill_input_per_ttft_per_request: input_tokens / median request TTFT; includes scheduling, PLE, GPU work, and first-token delivery.
metric_definitions.decode_one_per_tpot_per_request: 1 / median request TPOT; includes speculative decoding.

r53_vs_r56.configured_difference: FlashInfer autotune off -> fresh autotune on; fused finalize, file loading, and cache reuse stayed off.

quality.interpretation: Mechanical completion is not semantic or quality parity.

historical_published_comparison.workload_difference: Published run used warm PLE and repeated technical text; current R52/R56 use cold-cache frozen public-code prompts.
historical_published_comparison.warning: The published README does not state original acceptance metadata; these acceptance values come from the separate local reproduction audit, not from the README.
